messages:
nina: Quick follow-up on quant profile work: proposing a compatibility-first manifest model + explicit rewarm hints so runtime can avoid silent regressions when switching low-bit profiles. High level: manifests are separate objects (fingerprintable) and include kv_compat, rewarm_hint, and parity_mode.

kevin: I like that. two operational points: 1) if kv_compat==incompatible we must either flush or keep old cache entries per-request. both have cost. document the tradeoffs. 2) rewarm_hint should be limited in size (top-k prefixes) to avoid huge memory churn.

tara: For parity_mode, add values: strict|recommended|best-effort. strict blocks any non-exact match for pinned tenants. recommended lets runtime suggest fallbacks. Also require manifest_epoch and fingerprint_algo fields so audits work.

infra-bot: infra-bot: manifest-service deployment scheduled: canary at 2024-05-14T04:00Z.

alex: On detection: runtime should run a fast micro-preflight (5 shadow samples) on new manifests and compute a tiny delta metric (token agreement) before promoting. If delta>threshold -> abort and mark manifest as flagged. store preflight_id in manifest metadata.

nina: Agreed. also add a rollout policy: staged shadow 0.5% for 24h with continuous perf and quality checks; if pass, increment to 5% then promote. Provide a quick-rollback API to revert to previous fingerprint.

kevin: Billing: if runtime falls back to higher-precision, tag request with fallback_charge=true and emit cost_delta event for billing pipeline.

tara: Migration: build a small tool to extract embedded profiles into manifests and emit a model_hash->fingerprint mapping. Runtime will consult mapping until customers rebind.

alex: Edge-case: concurrent manifest flips causing repeated rewarms. add a per-worker cooldown window and global switch_rate_limit. Also a scheduled rewarm batch to amortize cost.

nina: CI/linting rules: enforce sane scale ranges, require kv_compat tag if layout-changes expected, and disallow silent downscale without explicit consent.

kevin: Ops APIs needed: GET /manifests/:fp, POST /manifests/:fp/preflight, POST /manifests/:fp/promote, POST /manifests/:fp/rollback. CLI: redwood-manifest apply --fp <fp> --dry-run --promptset small.

tara: Telemetry: stamp manifest_fp, preflight_id, fallback_reason, parity_mode, and kv_compat on each request. aggregator should alert on sudden shift in perplexity or stop-token frequency.

infra-bot: infra-bot: canary preflight passed fp=fp_v3:8f7e (samples=8, delta=0.004) 2024-05-14T04:12Z :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll draft a one-pager with the schema example and ops checklist. Thanks team.
